connector.name: Proxyllm MCP
connector.registryDescription: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway: models, savings math, key provisioning, autonomous email-OTP signup
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package proxyllm-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.proxyllm, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROXYLLM_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
env.description: Optional sk_/rk_ account token for management tools. Create one autonomously via the proxyllm_signup tool or https://proxyllm.ai/auth.md

env.name: PROXYLLM_ROUTING_KEY
env.description: Optional pllm_ routing key for key introspection and key-scoped model lists.
